results.note: 达梦直连 SQL（不经 API/解析）· read · P95 阈值 1500ms · P99 阈值 3000ms
results.sql_preview:
WITH base AS (
        SELECT
            device_addr,
            TRUNC(device_upload_time, 'HH24')
                + (FLOOR(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(device_upload_time, 'MI')) / 10) * 10) / 1440 AS bucket_time,
            instantaneous_value,
            average_value,
            warning_level,
            rate_change,
            risk_level
        FROM biz_atmosphere_electric_field_event
        WHERE device_addr IN ('ATM-DS-STD-001', 'ATM-DS-STD-002', 'ATM-DS-STD-003', 'ATM-DS-STD-004', 'ATM-DS-STD-005')
          AND device_upload_time >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-07-28 00:08:00.000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3')
          AND device_upload_time < TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-07-28 02:31:00.000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3')
    )
    SELECT
        device_addr,
        bucket_time AS device_upload_time,
        AVG(instantaneous_value) AS instantaneous_value,
        AVG(average_value) AS average_value,
        MAX(warning_level) AS warning_level,
        AVG(rate_change) AS rate_change,
        MAX(risk_level) AS risk_level,
        COUNT(*) AS point_count
    FROM base
    GROUP BY device_addr, bucket_time
    ORDER BY device_addr, bucket_time

results.sql_preview:
WITH base AS (
        SELECT
            device_addr,
            TRUNC(device_upload_time, 'HH24')
                + (FLOOR(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(device_upload_time, 'MI')) / 10) * 10) / 1440 AS bucket_time,
            instantaneous_value,
            average_value,
            warning_level,
            rate_change,
            risk_level
        FROM biz_atmosphere_electric_field_event
        WHERE device_addr IN ('ATM-DS-STD-001', 'ATM-DS-STD-002', 'ATM-DS-STD-003', 'ATM-DS-STD-004', 'ATM-DS-STD-005')
          AND device_upload_time >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-07-28 00:08:00.000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3')
          AND device_upload_time < TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-07-28 02:31:00.000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3')
    )
    SELECT
        device_addr,
        bucket_time AS device_upload_time,
        AVG(instantaneous_value) AS instantaneous_value,
        AVG(average_value) AS average_value,
        MAX(warning_level) AS warning_level,
        AVG(rate_change) AS rate_change,
        MAX(risk_level) AS risk_level,
        COUNT(*) AS point_count
    FROM base
    GROUP BY device_addr, bucket_time
    ORDER BY device_addr, bucket_time

results.sqlPreview:
WITH base AS (
        SELECT
            device_addr,
            TRUNC(device_upload_time, 'HH24')
                + (FLOOR(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(device_upload_time, 'MI')) / 1) * 1) / 1440 AS bucket_time,
            instantaneous_value,
            average_value,
            warning_level,
            rate_change,
            risk_level
        FROM biz_atmosphere_electric_field_event
        WHERE device_addr IN ('ATM-DS-STD-001', 'ATM-DS-STD-002', 'ATM-DS-STD-003', 'ATM-DS-STD-004', 'ATM-DS-STD-005')
          AND device_upload_time >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-07-28 00:08:00.000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3')
          AND device_upload_time < TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-07-28 02:31:00.000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3')
    )
    SELECT
        device_addr,
        bucket_time AS device_upload_time,
        AVG(instantaneous_value) AS instantaneous_value,
        AVG(average_value) AS average_value,
        MAX(warning_level) AS warning_level,
        AVG(rate_change) AS rate_change,
        MAX(risk_level) AS risk_level,
        COUNT(*) AS point_count
    FROM base
    GROUP BY device_addr, bucket_time
    ORDER BY device_addr, bucket_time

section11_4.note: 达梦直连 SQL（不经 API/解析）· read · P95 阈值 1500ms · P99 阈值 3000ms
section11_4.sql_preview:
WITH base AS (
        SELECT
            device_addr,
            TRUNC(device_upload_time, 'HH24')
                + (FLOOR(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(device_upload_time, 'MI')) / 10) * 10) / 1440 AS bucket_time,
            instantaneous_value,
            average_value,
            warning_level,
            rate_change,
            risk_level
        FROM biz_atmosphere_electric_field_event
        WHERE device_addr IN ('ATM-DS-STD-001', 'ATM-DS-STD-002', 'ATM-DS-STD-003', 'ATM-DS-STD-004', 'ATM-DS-STD-005')
          AND device_upload_time >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-07-28 00:08:00.000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3')
          AND device_upload_time < TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-07-28 02:31:00.000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3')
    )
    SELECT
        device_addr,
        bucket_time AS device_upload_time,
        AVG(instantaneous_value) AS instantaneous_value,
        AVG(average_value) AS average_value,
        MAX(warning_level) AS warning_level,
        AVG(rate_change) AS rate_change,
        MAX(risk_level) AS risk_level,
        COUNT(*) AS point_count
    FROM base
    GROUP BY device_addr, bucket_time
    ORDER BY device_addr, bucket_time

results.name: 多电场仪雷暴过程窗曲线查询（1分钟聚合）
results.note: 达梦直连 SQL（不经 API/解析）· read · P95 阈值 1500ms · P99 阈值 3000ms
results.sql_preview:
WITH base AS (
        SELECT
            device_addr,
            TRUNC(device_upload_time, 'HH24')
                + (FLOOR(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(device_upload_time, 'MI')) / 1) * 1) / 1440 AS bucket_time,
            instantaneous_value,
            average_value,
            warning_level,
            rate_change,
            risk_level
        FROM biz_atmosphere_electric_field_event
        WHERE device_addr IN ('ATM-DS-STD-001', 'ATM-DS-STD-002', 'ATM-DS-STD-003', 'ATM-DS-STD-004', 'ATM-DS-STD-005')
          AND device_upload_time >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-07-28 00:08:00.000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3')
          AND device_upload_time < TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-07-28 02:31:00.000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3')
    )
    SELECT
        device_addr,
        bucket_time AS device_upload_time,
        AVG(instantaneous_value) AS instantaneous_value,
        AVG(average_value) AS average_value,
        MAX(warning_level) AS warning_level,
        AVG(rate_change) AS rate_change,
        MAX(risk_level) AS risk_level,
        COUNT(*) AS point_count
    FROM base
    GROUP BY device_addr, bucket_time
    ORDER BY device_addr, bucket_time

        SELECT
            device_addr,
            TRUNC(device_upload_time, 'HH24')
                + (FLOOR(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(device_upload_time, 'MI')) / 1) * 1) / 1440 AS bucket_time,
            instantaneous_value,
            average_value,
            warning_level,
            rate_change,
            risk_level
        FROM biz_atmosphere_electric_field_event
        WHERE device_addr IN ('ATM-DS-STD-001', 'ATM-DS-STD-002', 'ATM-DS-STD-003', 'ATM-DS-STD-004', 'ATM-DS-STD-005')
          AND device_upload_time >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-07-28 00:08:00.000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3')

results.sqlPreview:
WITH base AS (
        SELECT
            device_addr,
            TRUNC(device_upload_time, 'HH24')
                + (FLOOR(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(device_upload_time, 'MI')) / 1) * 1) / 1440 AS bucket_time,
            instantaneous_value,
            average_value,
            warning_level,
            rate_change,
            risk_level
        FROM biz_atmosphere_electric_field_event
        WHERE device_addr IN ('ATM-DS-STD-001', 'ATM-DS-STD-002', 'ATM-DS-STD-003', 'ATM-DS-STD-004', 'ATM-DS-STD-005')
          AND device_upload_time >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-07-28 00:08:00.000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3')
          AND device_upload_time < TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-07-28 02:31:00.000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3')
    )
    SELECT
        device_addr,
        bucket_time AS device_upload_time,
        AVG(instantaneous_value) AS instantaneous_value,
        AVG(average_value) AS average_value,
        MAX(warning_level) AS warning_level,
        AVG(rate_change) AS rate_change,
        MAX(risk_level) AS risk_level,
        COUNT(*) AS point_count
    FROM base
    GROUP BY device_addr, bucket_time
    ORDER BY device_addr, bucket_time

WITH base AS (
        SELECT
            device_addr,
            TRUNC(device_upload_time, 'HH24')
                + (FLOOR(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(device_upload_time, 'MI')) / 1) * 1) / 1440 AS bucket_time,
            instantaneous_value,
            average_value,
            warning_level,
            rate_change,
            risk_level
        FROM biz_atmosphere_electric_field_event
        WHERE device_addr IN ('ATM-DS-STD-001', 'ATM-DS-STD-002', 'ATM-DS-STD-003', 'ATM-DS-STD-004', 'ATM-DS-STD-005')
          AND device_upload_time >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-07-28 00:08:00.000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3')
          AND device_upload_time < TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-07-28 02:31:00.000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3')
    )
    SELECT
        device_addr,
        bucket_time AS device_upload_time,
        AVG(instantaneous_value) AS instantaneous_value,
        AVG(average_value) AS average_value,
        MAX(warning_level) AS warning_level,
        AVG(rate_change) AS rate_change,
        MAX(risk_level) AS risk_level,
        COUNT(*) AS point_count
    FROM base
    GROUP BY device_addr, bucket_time
    ORDER BY device_addr, bucket_time

results.sql_preview:
WITH base AS (
        SELECT
            device_addr,
            TRUNC(device_upload_time, 'HH24')
                + (FLOOR(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(device_upload_time, 'MI')) / 10) * 10) / 1440 AS bucket_time,
            instantaneous_value,
            average_value,
            warning_level,
            rate_change,
            risk_level
        FROM biz_atmosphere_electric_field_event
        WHERE device_addr IN ('ATM-DS-STD-001', 'ATM-DS-STD-002', 'ATM-DS-STD-003', 'ATM-DS-STD-004', 'ATM-DS-STD-005')
          AND device_upload_time >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-07-28 00:08:00.000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3')
          AND device_upload_time < TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-07-28 02:31:00.000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3')
    )
    SELECT
        device_addr,
        bucket_time AS device_upload_time,
        AVG(instantaneous_value) AS instantaneous_value,
        AVG(average_value) AS average_value,
        MAX(warning_level) AS warning_level,
        AVG(rate_change) AS rate_change,
        MAX(risk_level) AS risk_level,
        COUNT(*) AS point_count
    FROM base
    GROUP BY device_addr, bucket_time
    ORDER BY device_addr, bucket_time

results.sql_preview:
WITH base AS (
        SELECT
            device_addr,
            TRUNC(device_upload_time, 'HH24')
                + (FLOOR(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(device_upload_time, 'MI')) / 1) * 1) / 1440 AS bucket_time,
            instantaneous_value,
            average_value,
            warning_level,
            rate_change,
            risk_level
        FROM biz_atmosphere_electric_field_event
        WHERE device_addr IN ('ATM-DS-STD-001', 'ATM-DS-STD-002', 'ATM-DS-STD-003', 'ATM-DS-STD-004', 'ATM-DS-STD-005')
          AND device_upload_time >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-07-28 00:08:00.000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3')
          AND device_upload_time < TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-07-28 02:31:00.000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3')
    )
    SELECT
        device_addr,
        bucket_time AS device_upload_time,
        AVG(instantaneous_value) AS instantaneous_value,
        AVG(average_value) AS average_value,
        MAX(warning_level) AS warning_level,
        AVG(rate_change) AS rate_change,
        MAX(risk_level) AS risk_level,
        COUNT(*) AS point_count
    FROM base
    GROUP BY device_addr, bucket_time
    ORDER BY device_addr, bucket_time

-- perf06_geo_mode=bbox_then_dwithin
INSERT INTO perf06_cand_rowid (rid)
    SELECT /*+ INDEX(biz_lightning_event idx_biz_lightning_perf06_cover) */ l.ROWID
    FROM biz_lightning_event l
    WHERE l.strike_time >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-07-28 00:13:00.000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3') AND l.strike_time < TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-07-28 02:26:00.000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF3')
